This directory contains an adapted extract of OpenStreetMap data.
Copyright OpenStreetMap contributors.
Database license: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0.
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

The projected, filtered database gangnam.json remains available under ODbL 1.0.
Use of the rendered city must retain the visible OpenStreetMap attribution.
Road centrelines and building outlines are from OpenStreetMap; missing road
widths and building heights, materials, windows, lights and trees are rendering
assumptions, not a photogrammetric reconstruction of the city.

See provenance.json for the bounding box, exact query, source snapshot time,
raw response hash and transformation description. Rebuild with
node scripts/fetch-gangnam.mjs from the project directory.

street-points.json (v1.29) holds subway-entrance positions with exit numbers and
traffic-signal positions from OpenStreetMap for the area of the streamed tiles,
under the same ODbL 1.0 terms. See street-points.provenance.json for the query,
snapshot time and hashes; rebuild with node scripts/fetch-street-points.mjs.
The canopies, totems and signal masts drawn at those positions are generic
shapes, not surveys of the real structures.
